page.notes: The word "capta" in "quomodo capta 467" is struck through in print. "uabi" at the end of the first line is hyphenated across the line end; read as "ubi" with uncertainty. "quas" in "ob quas causas" is an abbreviated form and read as "quas" with some doubt. Pencil marks in the margin and over "formidabile", "Deus" and "evertendum" are handwriting and not printed. "oppri-mendi" is a split word at the line end; the hyphen is inferred. Long s is transcribed as s throughout.
